title: Respondeo Liturgy of the Hours content file
description: One file of proper texts. Several files may be merged; text keys and celebration ids must be unique across all files.

schemaVersion.description: Content schema version. This build supports 1 to 2.

isSample.description: True for invented placeholder text; false only for licensed texts.

acknowledgment.description: Copyright acknowledgment displayed with licensed texts (must include ©, ICEL, and 'All rights reserved').

celebrations.description: Celebration metadata keyed by celebration id.

common.description: The common (e.g. martyrs, virgins) whose texts fill in what the proper lacks.

texts.description: Texts keyed from most to least specific, e.g. 'ordinary/w2/monday/morning/hymn', 'morning/hymn', 'hymn'.

text.description: The text, with line breaks preserved.

antiphon.description: The antiphon said before and after.
